owner: Bangladesh Data Center Company Limited (BDCCL), state-owned
notes: State-owned national data centre at Bangabandhu Hi-Tech City, Kaliakair, Gazipur (Dhaka division); runs national systems (e-governance, e-filing, health/social services, NID). Established 2019, described as largest in Bangladesh with Tier IV marketing claims (Grade B for capacity claims: ~200,000 sq ft, generators, cost figures per DCD/Dhaka Tribune). DCD reports BDCCL equipped its data centers with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in 2024.
